locator: Section VI, Réunion and Mauritius, p. 182; Seychelles, p. 183. Row 1897, La Réunion. / Table 69, p. 254, history of enumerations and censuses on the island. Row 1902, La Réunion.
scope: Réunion island alone; outside metropolitan France, Mauritius and Madagascar.
method: Linear interpolation over 914/1825. July 1 is a computational midpoint for year-only returns. 1904 Basutoland day follows the imperial census report p. 71.
uncertainty_kind: No statistical interval. Enumeration-day and between-census variation are unquantified.
